claims.text: Most reviewers find the brushes very soft and dense, often exceeding expectations.
Several reviewers report a chemical or paint-like smell when opening the set, though some did not notice any odor.
A number of reviewers report shedding or hairs falling out, while others say there was no shedding.
Reviewers frequently praise the included case as cute and convenient, though some note it is plastic and may be flimsy.
Some reviewers find the brushes smaller and lower quality than expected, while others consider them a great value for the price.
